Cider can trigger a headache ` [Highlight start] due to natural plant compounds like tannins, fermentation byproducts, sulfites, or alcohol-related dehydration and blood vessel changes [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wmZYftZHZS_PSTRO4pEs0XKwtOw-VYT6Un2mR595AkbHxfFemkE0mzyMvAjLbRG-dNpNRs0vliGS46kSSXzqZri6F1xhHVhCOl3DTxznpF0IEjPAeRiB2teps3OxpPVMS1-mBHUBDFebmbSMDyA8NdiPl5FGxuEyWsSPrf0uy2s)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF17GvsfrArbFODGo4MjPp1WyRKoXt0LeNQoSciFCZbEARSXaeVyb1t7BPptYSDlFQlPnYuvSL294atdYBygGBsLInUMb_nkkuqUx6l0pzSOqckwrYIKstVPXg3f6G7cwmd8s8TDwH4-9oQDkV6OBRD8CO91MfUxAHsvpR34IlDlZO-H461iQUYkzzxP1B)

### Common Causes of Cider Headaches

- **Tannins:** Found naturally in apple skins and cider, tannins can trigger serotonin shifts that affect blood vessels in the brain and provoke headaches or migraines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX0sVaGIN7Myny2mIvBuCvPHEaWY8_wP40OwIb21LwWFcjJzCHZX2ql3zp9PSRhnl_3Y7ZJbrATXVG9eA21p3ZYLjLOKaF0G5xxVxgc_BMpnK8ajzTcChfca4UTg9RPvGr9oQJB58_hW-kDpg00ZtzCIbmk60ZEw)
- **Fermentation byproducts:** Compounds like acetaldehyde, fusel alcohols, and histamines can form during fermentation and irritate tissues or dilate blood vessels. Most users on [Homebrew Talk](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF17GvsfrArbFODGo4MjPp1WyRKoXt0LeNQoSciFCZbEARSXaeVyb1t7BPptYSDlFQlPnYuvSL294atdYBygGBsLInUMb_nkkuqUx6l0pzSOqckwrYIKstVPXg3f6G7cwmd8s8TDwH4-9oQDkV6OBRD8CO91MfUxAHsvpR34IlDlZO-H461iQUYkzzxP1B) agree that sulfites can also play a role in headaches after drinking cider.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wmZYftZHZS_PSTRO4pEs0XKwtOw-VYT6Un2mR595AkbHxfFemkE0mzyMvAjLbRG-dNpNRs0vliGS46kSSXzqZri6F1xhHVhCOl3DTxznpF0IEjPAeRiB2teps3OxpPVMS1-mBHUBDFebmbSMDyA8NdiPl5FGxuEyWsSPrf0uy2s)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF17GvsfrArbFODGo4MjPp1WyRKoXt0LeNQoSciFCZbEARSXaeVyb1t7BPptYSDlFQlPnYuvSL294atdYBygGBsLInUMb_nkkuqUx6l0pzSOqckwrYIKstVPXg3f6G7cwmd8s8TDwH4-9oQDkV6OBRD8CO91MfUxAHsvpR34IlDlZO-H461iQUYkzzxP1B)
- **Alcohol and sugar effects:** If you are drinking hard cider, alcohol acts as a diuretic and widens blood vessels . High sugar content in cider alongside alcohol can also contribute to dehydration and blood sugar swings.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXCyFNOOA71kHXQK6Wzat00LI3akKtGUxgiiYdElZQQNfFdl5dV2uKXLkSAwHMRwexRm_xOJqOZTWeeNy2xMPobSiIBuRHWAJ9X6ks9C_3Xb5Rv4H65jvgnMh22fhJSpbdvSprFcHCgCeyLSFCU6uDQJRHVNY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wmZYftZHZS_PSTRO4pEs0XKwtOw-VYT6Un2mR595AkbHxfFemkE0mzyMvAjLbRG-dNpNRs0vliGS46kSSXzqZri6F1xhHVhCOl3DTxznpF0IEjPAeRiB2teps3OxpPVMS1-mBHUBDFebmbSMDyA8NdiPl5FGxuEyWsSPrf0uy2s)
- **Personal sensitivities:** Enzyme differences (such as slower acetaldehyde breakdown) or migraine tendencies can make you more sensitive even to small amounts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF165Y-Gh5_Fy4TJxX77A9idQkt03GJQgWeCqmirmuhC8uv73ohdIfHdTCeerO0KYAE4yjxtyBDdRQDScLs_Qi3e7RY-m_tFEqMOERnufHub6IwbJmeLKKyaOsRdygUo8bmA2NTEXhKG5JJl3bSYFNl6G8CwYjXmUIHNL9INEcWZ7WWrwOArA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXRal9iBMZ6wonfr3ASD9XhvORNS7PGgtXw2vhBZwRLKxjQZ-1HNyglZvIWiy67BIc6Mpnq_Lh1r0Qm0LOOwa-vUYiZjWpCwdSA-wRceQlzUVHc7aQBF25jhLbhdNwr86RTvzGVXVR)

### Ways to Lower Your Risk

- **Drink water alongside it:** Alternate cider with water to reduce dehydration.
- **Don't drink on an empty stomach:** Eating helps slow alcohol absorption and stabilize blood sugar.
- **Watch your portion size:** Limit how much you drink, especially with sweet or high-ABV ciders.
- **Avoid mixing with certain pain relievers:** Check with a doctor or pharmacist before taking acetaminophen with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXg8WwFk3YkyYQTq3dqLj31ro9zP4KiX1zq7nUOnvJMxdXrRudzSZBXAs05U2O7z2UYt71PTnGG0__WW-p8As-SIWSfHH9SWQdZwGgV3oP6pUq9aDOIX9Hd92DSUYgNFkBh2zkHAc02T700pQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wmZYftZHZS_PSTRO4pEs0XKwtOw-VYT6Un2mR595AkbHxfFemkE0mzyMvAjLbRG-dNpNRs0vliGS46kSSXzqZri6F1xhHVhCOl3DTxznpF0IEjPAeRiB2teps3OxpPVMS1-mBHUBDFebmbSMDyA8NdiPl5FGxuEyWsSPrf0uy2s)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXCyFNOOA71kHXQK6Wzat00LI3akKtGUxgiiYdElZQQNfFdl5dV2uKXLkSAwHMRwexRm_xOJqOZTWeeNy2xMPobSiIBuRHWAJ9X6ks9C_3Xb5Rv4H65jvgnMh22fhJSpbdvSprFcHCgCeyLSFCU6uDQJRHVNY)

- Whether **other drinks or foods** trigger similar headaches for you

items.title: Common Causes of Cider Headaches
items.text: Tannins: Found naturally in apple skins and cider, tannins can trigger serotonin shifts that affect blood vessels in the brain and provoke headaches or migraines. Fermentation byproducts: Compounds like acetaldehyde, fusel alcohols, and histamines can form during fermentation and irritate tissues or dilate blood vessels. Most users on Homebrew Talk agree that sulfites can also play a role in headaches after drinking cider. Alcohol and sugar effects: If you are drinking hard cider, alcohol acts as a diuretic and widens blood vessels. High sugar content in cider alongside alcohol can also contribute to dehydration and blood sugar swings. Personal sensitivities: Enzyme differences (such as slower acetaldehyde breakdown) or migraine tendencies can make you more sensitive even to small amounts.
